statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail risk is low on an orderly, two-sided overnight tape, while Stress stays elevated because of the day's scheduled catalyst stack.
recommendation: Current mapped state is EA_ON with Tail at 11%. A narrow conditional caution band is flagged for 20:00-22:00 UTC around Nvidia's Q2 FY2027 results, where the modelled forecast Tail reaches the block threshold. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected by this mapping.
headline: Quiet pre-PCE overnight tape; conditional risk concentrates around the Nvidia results window
body: The Nasdaq-100 closed Tuesday at 29,209.23, up 0.64%, inside a 29,077.72-29,338.77 range and about 130 points below the session high, so the cash session ended without holding an extreme. NQ futures near 29,262 are little changed through the Asian session and Finviz's delayed cross-asset context shows NQ around -0.2%, consistent with a contained overnight range rather than directional extension. VIX near 15.4 is subdued. WTI has fallen a third consecutive session toward $80 and Brent toward $86 as Iran and Oman discuss a temporary joint maritime corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, which is a disinflationary and index-supportive input at the margin. Treasury yields stand near 4.24% at 2Y and 4.70% at 10Y on the latest H.15 observation, and the 19 August yield-driven equity drawdown keeps the rates channel as the standing macro vulnerability. Latest-session breadth is constructive but rotational: technology +1.04% and semiconductors +1.86%, with megacaps split four up and four down. On that evidence there is no observed persistent one-way structure, no repeated extension after failed retracements and no cross-asset amplifier stack, so Tail is held at 11%. Stress is carried at 52% because the scheduled catalyst load is heavy: July Core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP, durable goods and personal income and spending all print at 12:30Z, EIA inventories follow at 14:30Z, Fed Barkin speaks at 15:45Z, and Nvidia reports Q2 FY2027 results at approximately 20:20Z with the analyst call at 21:00Z. The Nvidia sequence is the single structural concern in the forward window: a heavily index-weighted name repricing across a release, written commentary and then a guidance Q&A, in thin post-close liquidity, is a credible multi-stage mechanism for a leg that does not retrace. That is why the forecast Tail crosses the block threshold only for 20:00-22:00 UTC and decays afterwards. Confidence is 88% on verified index levels, futures, VIX, yields, oil, calendar and catalyst timing, together with fresh shared cross-asset context.

lookbackSummary: Across the last 24 published hourly assessments the mapped state stayed green apart from a five-hour yellow WATCH stretch between 09:00Z and 13:40Z on 25 August, when Tail sat at 20-21% during a trend-up phase. Tail peaked at 21% and then decayed steadily to 9-12% through the U.S. afternoon and overnight, while the dominant mode moved from trend-up to mixed and then to normal. Stress held in a narrow 45-51% band throughout and Confidence stayed at 84-88%, so the series describes a gradually calming tape rather than an escalating one.
outlookSummary: The forward 24 hours contain two distinct scheduled clusters. The first is the 12:30Z macro block, where Core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and durable goods print together and conditional Tail is modelled at 21-22% through the release and the 13:30Z U.S. cash open, mapping to a yellow WATCH state. The second is the Nvidia sequence, with results at approximately 20:20Z and the analyst call at 21:00Z, where conditional Tail is modelled at 26-27% and crosses into the orange BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES band for 20:00-22:00 UTC before easing back to watch and then low levels overnight. Between and after those clusters the modelled path returns toward a 13-18% baseline. All forward structure is conditional: no post-release or post-earnings price path is treated as observed, and an orderly path with visible retracements would justify faster decay than modelled here.
